# Vendored crates

| Crate | Version | Licence | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| winit | 0.30.13 | Apache-2.0 | Copied from PdfCraft's `vendor/winit` (every patch is marked `PdfCraft patch:` in the source). For the Android build (`apps/vectorcraft-android`): a mouse delivers cursor, button and wheel events instead of touches, a hovering stylus moves the cursor, and a touch's tool type (finger, stylus, eraser, mouse, palm) rides in bits 32..40 of `Touch::id`. PdfCraft's Windows and Wayland fixes come with it. Remove once a winit release covers these. |
| android-activity | 0.6.1 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | From the [v0.6.1 tag](https://github.com/rust-mobile/android-activity/tree/v0.6.1/android-activity) (the workspace's `readme` path pointed at this folder's copy of its README). One patch, marked `VectorCraft patch:` in `src/native_activity/glue.rs`: the thread that runs `android_main` (and so the whole UI) is started with a 64 MiB stack instead of std's 2 MiB default, which a desktop main thread (8 MiB) doesn't have to live with; a stack overflow aborts the app with no panic for the guard to catch. Upstream has no way to choose it, and the thread must be the one that owns the looper, so the app can't move to a bigger thread itself. |
